verdict.rationale: Scribe is itself a documented public API. The AI Services reference publishes an OpenAPI spec, confirmed live by a probe, covering synchronous transcription, batch job submit/status/list/cancel/files, and the Live WebSocket. Vocabulary assets have CRUD endpoints, credentials are scoped and support JWT, and batch jobs can send signed webhooks, so the product can be driven entirely through the API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real API calls beyond the docs and spec probes; the reference and the probed payload also disagree on the OpenAPI version (3.1.1 vs 3.0.0).
